purpose: 21 ORIGINAL NativeZipper complete rational rows at physically constructible common widths (seven maps,n=1,2),plus238 dimension/fuel/zero/width checks (seven maps,n=0..33). Dimension words deliberately include an extra high zero to test noncanonical sufficient widths. Full rows compare with direct rational overlap and check all word/stream/fuel/scratch/head obligations through the original checkCase harness. Row words/guard are prepared;the test does not claim an integrated initialization-and-row machine or a logarithmic-source budget for every overpadded example.
source:
import TransposeFollowup.PaddedWordWidth
open TransposeFollowup
def identityMap : RationalMobius where
  a := 1
  b := 0
  c := 0
  d := 1
  lo := 0
  hi := 1
  interval_nonempty := by norm_num
  determinant_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_lo_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_hi_pos := by norm_num

def doubleMap : RationalMobius where
  a := 2
  b := 0
  c := 0
  d := 1
  lo := 0
  hi := 1 / 2
  interval_nonempty := by norm_num
  determinant_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_lo_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_hi_pos := by norm_num

def fractionalMap : RationalMobius where
  a := 1
  b := 0
  c := 1
  d := 1
  lo := 0
  hi := 1
  interval_nonempty := by norm_num
  determinant_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_lo_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_hi_pos := by norm_num


def shiftMap : RationalMobius where
  a := 1; b := -1; c := 0; d := 1; lo := 0; hi := 1
  interval_nonempty := by norm_num
  determinant_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_lo_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_hi_pos := by norm_num

def poleMap : RationalMobius where
  a := 1; b := 0; c := -2; d := 1; lo := 0; hi := 1 / 4
  interval_nonempty := by norm_num
  determinant_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_lo_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_hi_pos := by norm_num

def coefficientMap : RationalMobius where
  a := 1 / 2; b := 1 / 3; c := 1 / 5; d := 1; lo := -1 / 2; hi := 3 / 4
  interval_nonempty := by norm_num
  determinant_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_lo_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_hi_pos := by norm_num

def outsideMap : RationalMobius where
  a := 1; b := 0; c := 0; d := 1; lo := 2; hi := 3
  interval_nonempty := by norm_num
  determinant_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_lo_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_hi_pos := by norm_num

def cases : List RationalMobius :=
  [identityMap, doubleMap, fractionalMap, shiftMap, poleMap, coefficientMap, outsideMap]



open FixedTapeCompiler CopyMachine

def bits (m a : Nat) : List Bool := (List.range m).map a.testBit

def wordIndex : RowCell.WordPort → Nat
  | (g,side,sign) => 4*(match g with | .threshold => 0 | .crossing => 1 | .delta => 2) +
      2*side.toNat+sign.toNat

def cellPortIndex : RowCell.Port → Nat
  | .word p => wordIndex p | .fuel => 12 | .zero => 13 | .scratch b => 14+b.toNat

def portIndex : RowStream.Port → Nat
  | .cell p => cellPortIndex p | .counter => 16 | .stream => 17

def allWordPorts : List RowCell.WordPort :=
  [RowCell.Group.threshold,.crossing,.delta].flatMap (fun g =>
    [false,true].flatMap (fun side => [false,true].map (fun sign => (g,side,sign))))

def allCellPorts : List RowCell.Port :=
  allWordPorts.map RowCell.Port.word ++ [.fuel,.zero,.scratch false,.scratch true]

def allPorts : List RowStream.Port := allCellPorts.map RowStream.Port.cell ++ [.counter,.stream]

def heads (p : RowStream.Port) : Int := 7*(portIndex p : Int)-43

def encoded (m : Nat) (v : RowCell.WordPort → Nat) : RowCell.Words := fun p => bits m (v p)

def modularAnswer (guard : Bool) (m : Nat) (v : RowCell.WordPort → Nat) : Bool :=
  guard && decide ((v (.threshold,false,false)+v (.crossing,false,true))%2^m <
    (v (.crossing,false,false)+v (.threshold,false,true))%2^m) &&
    decide ((v (.crossing,true,false)+v (.threshold,true,true))%2^m <
      (v (.threshold,true,false)+v (.crossing,true,true))%2^m)

def nextValues (m : Nat) (v : RowCell.WordPort → Nat) : RowCell.WordPort → Nat
  | (.crossing,i) => (v (.crossing,i)+v (.delta,i))%2^m
  | p => v p

def numericRun (guard : Bool) (m : Nat) : Nat → (RowCell.WordPort → Nat) → List Bool × (RowCell.WordPort → Nat)
  | 0, v => ([],v)
  | k+1, v => let rest := numericRun guard m k (nextValues m v)
             (modularAnswer guard m v :: rest.1, rest.2)

def checkCase (guard : Bool) (m : Nat) (v : RowCell.WordPort → Nat)
    (fuel priorBits expected : List Bool) : Bool := Id.run do
  let initial : RowStream.State m := ⟨encoded m v, by intro p; simp [encoded,bits], priorBits⟩
  let final := NativeZipper.run RowStream.program (RowStream.budget m fuel)
    (RowStream.zipperCfg false (.counter guard 0) fuel initial heads)
  let numeric := numericRun guard m (Counter.value fuel) v
  let clean := fun b => decide ((final.core.tapes (.cell (.scratch b))).left = [.start]) &&
    (final.core.tapes (.cell (.scratch b))).right.all (fun s => decide (s = .blank))
  return decide (final.core.pc = .done guard) && decide (numeric.1 = expected) &&
    allWordPorts.all (fun p => decide (final.core.tapes (.cell (.word p)) = BinaryCarry.marked (bits m (numeric.2 p)))) &&
    decide (final.core.tapes (.cell .fuel) = Counter.marked [true]) &&
    decide (final.core.tapes (.cell .zero) = BinaryCarry.marked (List.replicate m false)) &&
    decide (final.core.tapes .counter = Counter.marked (List.replicate fuel.length true)) &&
    decide (final.core.tapes .stream = RowStream.closedTape (priorBits ++ expected)) &&
    clean false && clean true &&
    allPorts.all (fun p => decide (final.pos p = heads p +
      if p = .stream then (priorBits.length + Counter.value fuel : Nat) else 0))

def rowValues (r : ComponentRow) (j : Nat) : RowCell.WordPort → Nat
  | (g,side,sign) =>
    let pair := match g with
      | .threshold => if side then r.upper else r.lower
      | .delta => if side then r.deltaRight else r.deltaLeft
      | .crossing => if side then r.deltaRight.scale j else r.deltaLeft.scale (j+1)
    if sign then pair.negative else pair.positive


def wideRowChecks : Nat × Nat × Nat := Id.run do
  let mut rows := 0
  let mut widths := 0
  let mut failures := 0
  for F in cases do
    for n in List.range 34 do
      let xs := bits (n.size+1) n
      let C := PaddedWord.commonConstant F
      let fuel := PaddedWord.word C id xs
      widths := widths+1
      if !(Counter.value fuel == n && decide (F.componentWidth n ≤ fuel.length) &&
          decide (PaddedWord.word C (fun _ => false) xs = List.replicate fuel.length false)) then
        failures := failures+1
    for n in [1,2] do
      for i in List.finRange n do
        let r := F.componentRow i
        let fuel := PaddedWord.word (PaddedWord.commonConstant F) id (bits (n.size+1) n)
        let m := fuel.length
        rows := rows+1
        if !(checkCase (r.sourceLeft.less r.sourceRight) m (rowValues r 0) fuel [true,false]
            ((List.finRange n).map (fun j => F.overlapTest i j))) then failures := failures+1
  return (rows,widths,failures)
#eval wideRowChecks
